title.narrative: Rehabilitation of damaged bakeries in Syria

description.narrative: Rehabilitation of (33) damaged government bakeries in (8) Syrian governorates through essential repairs, provision of new production lines, and maintenance of dilapidated production lines, in addition to the rehabilitation of two mobile bread production units.

Rehabilitation of 30 damaged government bakeries, (2) Supply and installation of 13 new bread production lines, and (3) Rehabilitation and maintenance of 29 damaged bread production lines, in 8 Syrian governorates: Rural Damascus, Latakia, Daraa, Deir ez-Zor, and Homs. The governorates of As-Suwayda, Hama, and Aleppo. (4) In addition to repairing two mobile bread production units.

To enhance food security for the most vulnerable communities, especially in areas with large numbers of returnees, internally displaced persons, and host communities, by rehabilitating government bakeries in the targeted areas, providing new production lines, repairing dilapidated production lines, and transferring and repairing two mobile bread production units. This aims to ensure the availability of sufficient bread to meet needs sustainably.
